refused_program.intent: Replay the local branch's commits on top of upstream so the history stays linear.

postconditions.description: upstream's tip is contained in HEAD
postconditions.name: upstream_is_ancestor_of_head

postconditions.description: HEAD carries local commits beyond upstream
postconditions.name: replayed_commits_present

postconditions.description: no merge commits among the replayed local commits
postconditions.name: history_is_linear

postconditions.description: the working tree is clean after the rebase
postconditions.name: worktree_clean_after

postconditions.description: the rebase completed and left nothing in progress
postconditions.name: no_rebase_in_progress
postconditions.probe:
test ! -e "$(git rev-parse --git-path rebase-merge)" &&
test ! -e "$(git rev-parse --git-path rebase-apply)"

preconditions.description: the remote-tracking ref for the upstream branch is present
preconditions.name: upstream_ref_exists

preconditions.description: HEAD has local-only commits and upstream has commits HEAD lacks
preconditions.name: local_and_upstream_diverged

preconditions.description: no staged, unstaged or untracked changes
preconditions.name: worktree_clean

preconditions.description: HEAD is attached to a local branch
preconditions.name: on_local_branch

preconditions.description: no rebase, merge or cherry-pick is in progress
preconditions.name: no_operation_in_progress
preconditions.probe:
test ! -e "$(git rev-parse --git-path rebase-merge)" &&
test ! -e "$(git rev-parse --git-path rebase-apply)" &&
test ! -e "$(git rev-parse --git-path MERGE_HEAD)" &&
test ! -e "$(git rev-parse --git-path CHERRY_PICK_HEAD)"

preconditions.description: local-only commits and upstream commits touch disjoint paths, so the replay applies cleanly
preconditions.name: no_overlapping_changes
preconditions.probe:
base=$(git merge-base HEAD {upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch}) &&
! comm -12 \
  <(git diff --name-only -z "$base" HEAD | tr '\0' '\n' | sort) \
  <(git diff --name-only -z "$base" {upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch} | tr '\0' '\n' | sort) | grep -q .
